remarks: *Lot 11: "The Birch": MARCH 2025 COMPLETION* The Reserve at Sterling Ridge is a new, private enclave of eleven luxury homes sited on a beautiful tree-lined drive - Walking distance to shopping/dining, just 6 miles to the coast, and a quick train ride to NYC. Each residence features designer-curated aesthetics with a nod to the timeless architecture of historic New England. A collaboration between HOBI Award-winning architect and building team. Exceptional features include: Hardieboard siding, Marvin windows, Thermador appliances, 9-ft+ & cathedral ceilings, custom cabinetry/millwork, gourmet kitchens, Spabaths w/ rainfall showers and radiant floor heat, EV charger, more. On the main level find an office/playroom, dining area, fireplaced family room, and stunning kitchen all bordered by a dramatic wall of glass sliding doors to the expansive rear patio - The largest outdoor hardscape in the development. Upstairs, the thoughtful design incorporates everything you'd want: Primary suite with fireplace & cathedral ceiling, 2 walk-in closets, and Spabath; 2 additional bedrooms with Jack & Jill bath; Guest/Junior Suite with ensuite bath; linen closet, enviable laundry room, and an open foyer to the walk-up third level. Inquire for additional options & customizations.
